title: Associate - Sourcing Recruiter
jobDescription: Need a Corporate Sourcing Recruiter with basic understanding of recruiting and 1+ year of hands-on experience with sourcing resumes for open roles Following is the JD for your reference: We are looking for a Sourcing Specialist to join our growing Corporate Recruiting team. In this role, you will leverage various sourcing channels to build a strong talent pipeline for Artech’s current and future hiring needs. This entails formulation and execution of various sourcing strategies to attract passive as well as active talent pool of candidates, for open jobs and passing-on the leads for interested candidates to the Corp Recruiting team so that they can screen them further for the various open jobs. Responsibilities Focus primarily on sourcing, attracting, and engaging passive prospects for Artech’s US offices, specifically for recruiting and sales roles. Approaching passive candidates and convince them to pursue an open position. Leverage platforms including LinkedIn, Job Diva, Careerbuilder, Indeed and social media to actively engage top prospects and build awareness for job opportunities with Artech Build relationships with individuals and with pools of talent in support of current and future hiring needs Proactively network for referrals that will identify additional talent for the firm. Expertise in both traditional and advanced talent sourcing techniques including full proficiency with Boolean search tactics. Build a pipeline of qualified candidates through researching, prospecting, and active networking using various sourcing channels such as external resume databases, social media, alumni networks, professional organizations, and referrals. Collaborate with team members to create innovative sourcing and recruitment strategies. Keeps Job Diva - Applicant Tracking System (ATS) updated at all times Submit candidates to the corporate recruiting team for further qualification and interest in available opportunities. Simultaneously manage multiple searches and support multiple recruiting partners Understanding ongoing hiring needs of their business and establishing the right sourcing mix to generate a strong pool of talent for open roles. Drafting & publishing attractive job advertisement and managing responses. Performs other administrative tasks as needed Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field. 1+ year of progressive recruiting experience, preferably in a consulting or agency environment. Demonstrated experience in creating and executing creative sourcing strategies for active and passive talent through various sourcing channels such as: LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, social media, professional organizations, etc. Demonstrated ability to drive results, must possess strong execution skills, and a willingness to work on tactical and routine tasks. Well versed with Applicant Tracking Systems, preferably Job Diva. Work collaboratively on teams and consult effectively and independently with all levels of the organization. Must feel comfortable working in a Night Shift (EST). Must be detail oriented, self-directed, excellent follow-through, and the ability to multi-task. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficient in MS Office including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook Need a Corporate Sourcing Recruiter with basic understanding of recruiting and 1+ year of hands-on recruitment sourcing experience.

title: Manager - Finance (T&L)
jobDescription: The Time & Labor Manager is responsible for managing the critical functions of the HCM/Time System. This role will also consult with Contractor Care dept and business to deliver a comprehensive Time system solution, and to guide the team towards the best solution for their business needs. Additionally, the Manager will work cross functionally with other leaders and contribute to overall product vision, strategy, and direction of Time and Attendance team and products. Qualifications: • 6+ years of Timesheet management experience with 3 - 5 years in leading a team of 15-20 members in a multinational shared services environment • Exposure to managing global clients • Outstanding attention to detail, problem-solving, and analytical skills • Expert level proficiency in Microsoft Excel • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines • Experience in managing timesheets on an ERP system preferably Oracle/PeopleSoft • Understands continuous improvement concepts and capable of driving it • Hands on experience in change management / process excellence What You'll Do In this role you will supervise a team of 10-20 members and will be accountable for achieving operational targets related to auditing expense reimbursements and timesheet processing agreed with business. In this role, you will comply with policies and procedures and strive for operational excellence. You will determine a strategy for continuous improvement projects without compromising on controls and compliance. You will regularly analyze the process, identify improvement areas, and recommend new ideas to improve the overall process and thereby improving customer satisfaction. You will partner with functional leadership to identify issues, gather necessary information, use the right information for solving problems, and come up with practical solutions. You will ensure policy changes, business process documentations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are updated regularly. You will be responsible for assessing the team members’ performance objectively and will identify the training needs to continue to develop their skills. You will facilitate and impart functional training for team members. The Time & Labor Manager is responsible for managing the critical functions of the HCM/Time System. This role will also consult with Contractor Care dept and business to deliver a comprehensive Time system solution, and to guide the team towards the best solution for their business needs.
